description: Read a brand's keywords (what the always-on extension searches on X, Quora, Pinterest, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and the server on Reddit), or REPLACE the list (owner/admin token): keywords = product names, ingredients, the problems its buyers search for, #hashtags; up to 40; every keyword is machine time on every network. The answer carries the sweep state per network.

category.description: The brand's niche, e.g. Hair care.

keywords.description: Send to REPLACE the whole list (owner/admin). Omit to read.

networks.description: With keywords: x, quora, pinterest, reddit, instagram, tiktok, facebook (default: the server's set).

run.description: true = 'search now' (owner/admin): every keyword of the brand is marked asked; the always-on machine picks them up within five minutes, Reddit within 30. The answer's machine.extension_alive says whether anything will actually run.

name: viralhunt_brand_keywords
